headline: Draft high school program of studies, new high school construction update, and Potential Hazard Building capital projects.
summary: The agenda includes a vote on the draft Program of Studies for school year 2027-2028. It also lists an update on the new high school and athletic complex at Curtis Corner and a discussion of possible Potential Hazard Building capital projects.
items: FY27 budget-to-actual report as of October 31, 2026
Notice of approved fundraiser: SKHS Class of 2029 Chipotle Restaurant Night (Policy #2110)
Approval of SKHS Program of Studies for SY 2027-2028 (draft)
Status update on new South Kingstown High School and athletic field/stadium complex at Curtis Corner
Discussion of potential Hazard Building capital improvement projects
location: South Kingstown High School Cafeteria, 215 Columbia Street, Wakefield, RI 02879

6. Adjournment
A. Adjourn
The order of business maybe altered or suspended at any meeting by a majority of those present. A vote may be taken on any
